interface_detail: SFTP, SCP, rsync, FTPS, SMB/CIFS, WebDAV, BorgBackup, SSH (port 23); 100 sub-accounts; 10 concurrent connections
tooling: No S3 endpoint — this is the one real gap. rclone via SFTP or WebDAV; Borg/restic first-class
chaining: WebDAV -> AList -> Cloudflare works. 100 sub-accounts let you hand one directory each to separate services.
limits_note: 10 concurrent connections per box is the binding constraint for parallel ranged GET benchmarks (rule 6 in §1.4 applies: this host will NOT scale to 32 parallel streams). No object API, so no presigned URLs; every read goes through your WebDAV/SFTP proxy layer.
reliability_note: The most reliable option in this dossier by a wide margin — Hetzner's own DCs (FSN1/HEL1), RAID6, snapshots, 100k+ customer scale. Cost: aggressive new-account KYC. LET threads document ID-card scans being requested and accounts silently refused for country/risk reasons; UnionPay accepted but does not waive KYC.
